intro: 句式分两类用法：一类是骨架（句子结构，换掉里面的名词就能用），一类是血肉（具体搭配，必须跟着题目内容走）。只搬骨架不算模板化，整段照搬才会被判模板。

items.en: While some argue that ..., I would argue that ...
items.use: 开头一句把双方都点到，再给自己的立场

items.en: It is often claimed that ... . In my view, however, this argument overlooks ...
items.cn: 人们常说……，但在我看来这个说法忽略了……
items.use: 先复述对方，再指出漏洞，比直接否定更有力

items.en: Few issues are as divisive as ...
items.cn: 很少有议题像……这样引起分歧
items.use: 开头引入争议话题（适合讨论型）

items.en: In recent decades, ... has moved from the margins to the centre of public debate.
items.cn: 近几十年，……从边缘议题变成了公共讨论的中心
items.use: 强调话题的时代性，避免 With the development of society

items.en: This essay will examine both sides before explaining why I favour ...
items.cn: 本文先看双方，再说明我为什么支持……
items.use: 结尾句预告结构，CC 分好拿

items.en: The question is not whether ... is valuable, but how it should be ...
items.cn: 问题不在于……是否有价值，而在于它应当如何……
items.use: 把绝对化的题目改成可讨论的题目，最容易写深

items.en: Admittedly, ... ; nevertheless, ...
items.use: 先承认对方合理处，再转回来，是最稳的 7 分结构

items.en: It is true that ... , but this is only part of the picture.
items.cn: ……确实如此，但这只是事情的一部分
items.use: 反驳「只不过」类观点

items.en: Critics may contend that ... , yet such a view tends to ignore ...
items.cn: 批评者可能主张……，但这种看法往往忽略……
items.use: 带出对方立场并指出盲点

items.en: Granted, ... . Even so, the argument does not hold when ...
items.cn: 就算……成立，当……时这个论证也不成立
items.use: 加条件式反驳，显得思考有层次

items.en: This argument has some merit, but it does not withstand closer scrutiny.
items.cn: 这个论点有一定道理，但经不起细看
items.use: 一句收掉对方，进入自己的论证

items.en: Such reasoning confuses correlation with causation.
items.cn: 这种推理把相关当成了因果
items.use: 高级反驳，适合数据/研究型题目

items.en: This is largely attributable to ...
items.cn: 这在很大程度上归因于……
items.use: 给出主因，比 because 更书面

items.en: A further factor is ...
items.use: 补充第二个原因，替代 Secondly

items.en: ..., which in turn leads to ...
items.use: 写出因果链，是 TR 深度最直接的来源

items.en: The root of the problem lies not in ... but in ...
items.use: 把讨论从现象推进到机制

items.en: As a consequence, ...
items.use: 承接结果，替代 so

items.en: Unless ... , the problem is likely to persist.
items.cn: 除非……，否则问题会持续存在
items.use: 引出解决方案前的铺垫

items.en: A case in point is ...
items.use: 最省字的举例开头

items.en: Take ... , for example: ...
items.use: 举例后用冒号直接给细节

items.en: This is well illustrated by ...
items.use: 承接上文观点再举例

items.en: Evidence from ... suggests that ...
items.use: 引用研究/调查（编数据要谨慎，宁可用笼统表述）

items.en: In practice, however, ...
items.use: 从理论转到现实，避免空谈

items.en: Consider ... : if ... , then ...
items.use: 假设式论证，适合没有真实例子的题目

items.en: In conclusion, while ... , the benefits clearly outweigh the drawbacks.
items.cn: 总之，虽然……，但好处明显大于坏处
items.use: 利弊型题目的标准收束

items.en: Ultimately, the question is not whether ... but how ...
items.cn: 归根结底，问题不是要不要……，而是怎么……
items.use: 结尾再抬一层，TR 加分

items.en: What is needed, therefore, is not ... but ...
items.use: 给出方向而不是空喊口号

items.en: Governments and schools should therefore ... rather than ...
items.cn: 因此政府与学校应当……而不是……
items.use: 落到可执行主体

items.en: Only by ... can ... be ...
items.use: 强调句收尾，注意后面用倒装

groups.title: Task 1 · 趋势描述（上升/下降/波动/持平）

items.en: rose steadily from X in 2000 to Y in 2010
items.cn: 从 2000 年的 X 稳步上升到 2010 年的 Y
items.use: 上升 + 起止点，一句说清

items.en: declined sharply, falling by almost half
items.cn: 急剧下降，几乎减少一半
items.use: 下降 + 幅度

items.en: fluctuated between X and Y throughout the period
items.cn: 在此期间于 X 与 Y 之间波动
items.use: 波动，配 between ... and ...

items.en: remained relatively stable at around X
items.cn: 基本稳定在 X 左右
items.use: 持平，注意 at around

items.en: peaked at X in 2010 before falling back to Y
items.cn: 2010 年达到 X 的峰值，随后回落到 Y
items.use: 先升后降，比两个句子省一半字数

items.en: hit a low of X in 2005
items.use: 最低点

items.en: grew more than threefold over the decade
items.use: 倍数表达，注意 threefold 是「变为三倍」

items.en: overtook X to become the largest category
items.cn: 超过 X 成为占比最大的类别
items.use: 排名变化

items.en: accounted for roughly a third of the total
items.use: 占比，配 accounted for

items.en: was twice as high as X
items.use: 比较，注意 as ... as 结构

items.en: Overall, the most striking feature is that ...
items.cn: 总体来看，最显著的特点是……
items.use: 概述段开头，必须有这一段

items.en: The chart shows a clear upward trend in ...
items.cn: 图表显示……呈明显上升趋势
items.use: 概述趋势，不写具体数字

items.en: By contrast, ... accounted for the smallest share.
items.use: 两组数据对比

items.en: X and Y followed broadly similar patterns, although ...
items.cn: X 与 Y 走势大致相似，尽管……
items.use: 把两条线合并成一句，省字数

items.en: The gap between X and Y widened / narrowed over time.
items.cn: X 与 Y 之间的差距逐渐扩大 / 缩小
items.use: 差距变化，很出效果

items.en: Figures for X were consistently higher than those for Y.
items.cn: X 的数据始终高于 Y
items.use: those 代替重复的名词

groups.title: 学术衔接（按功能选，不要背一串）

items.en: Consequently, ...
items.use: 结果（句中已含因果，后面别再 because）

items.en: Nevertheless, ...
items.use: 转折，比 but 正式

items.en: Moreover, ...
items.use: 递进，一段最多用一次

items.en: In contrast, ...
items.use: 对比，前后必须是同类事物

items.en: Given that ... , ...
items.use: 前提 + 结论

items.en: With regard to ...
items.use: 切换讨论对象

items.en: This is particularly true of ...
items.use: 缩小范围，避免绝对化

items.en: To a large extent, ...
items.use: 给观点留余地

groups.title: 高频词升级（同一意思，换个更准的词）

items.en: important → crucial / vital / pivotal
items.use: pivotal 适合「关键转折」的语境

items.en: good → beneficial / advantageous / constructive
items.use: beneficial 配 for/to

items.en: bad → detrimental / damaging / adverse
items.use: detrimental to 健康/环境

items.en: big → substantial / considerable / significant
items.use: 修饰数量、影响

items.en: many → a growing number of / numerous
items.use: 可数名词；不可数用 a great deal of

items.en: think → believe / maintain / contend / argue
items.use: contend 带「主张」意味

items.en: show → demonstrate / illustrate / indicate
items.use: 图表用 illustrate，数据用 indicate

items.en: help → facilitate / foster / contribute to
items.use: foster 配能力、关系

items.en: problem → issue / challenge / drawback / shortcoming
items.use: drawback 指方案缺点

items.en: get → obtain / acquire / gain
items.use: acquire skills 搭配固定

items.en: change → shift / transform / alter
items.use: shift 常指态度、重心转移

items.en: because → owing to / due to / as a result of
items.use: 后接名词短语，不接从句

groups.title: 中式表达纠正（考官一眼能看出来的）

items.en: ✗ With the development of society → ✓ As societies develop,
items.use: 模板句，考场上出现太多次；换成具体变化

items.en: ✗ more and more people → ✓ a growing number of people
items.use: 口语化 + 重复，正式写作少用

items.en: ✗ In my opinion, I think ... → ✓ In my view, ...
items.use: 两个表达重复，删一个

items.en: ✗ I very like ... → ✓ I really enjoy / I am fond of ...
items.use: very 不能直接修饰动词

items.en: ✗ There have many people ... → ✓ There are many people ...
items.use: there be 句型不用 have

items.en: ✗ Last but not least, ... → ✓ Finally, / More importantly, ...
items.use: 口语套话，书面语不用

items.en: ✗ On the one hand ... on the other hand ... （用于并列）→ ✓ While ..., ...
items.use: 这组词本义是「对立」，不是「并列」

items.en: ✗ solve the problem（一段用三次）→ ✓ address / tackle / alleviate
items.use: 同一个动词别在一段里重复
